test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Coloquial**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the word in option 1 is incorrectly spelled.**
 
• The correct spelling is "Colloquial" with double 'l'.
 
 
• It means informal or conversational language.(बोलचाल की भाषा)
 
• Example: "The book was written in colloquial language, making it easy to understand for everyone." 
 
 
 
• All the other words in other options are spelled correctly.

Hence,** the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (Recommend) is correctly spelled and means to suggest or endorse something.(सिफारिश करना)
 
• Option 3 (Infection) is correctly spelled and means the invasion and multiplication of harmful microorganisms in a host organism.(संक्रमण)
 
• Option 4 (Occasion) is correctly spelled and means a particular event or time.(अवसर)
